第206章 4星副本灵境寺呦呦晋阶（第1页）
银童心升级的速度可比陈小草快的多。
一个月不到的时间，就已经赶上了陈小草的进度，来到了4星。
看着有些炫耀意味站在自己面前的银童心，陈小草嘴角勾了勾。
李团团，杨佳佳，给我按住她，我今天必须立一立一家之主的威
“哼”白天元一声冷哼，自己的计谋虽然没想过会奏效，但是，自己预计着怎么也能让他们的防守疏忽一些，自己好趁乱逃走，但是没想到，竟然都是不为所动。
如今的吕枫已经不记得自己拔了多少次剑了，开始的几天他也有些麻木，但后来，没一次尝试，他都认真的体会着，哪里不足，哪里有了进步，一时之间，倒也沉浸在其中。
李言而今已是五十成的控力，但达到圣境，哪个不是将控力练习到最巅峰？所以在这一点上李言并没有优势，仅靠着大荒神通最后一式的增幅之力，还是抵不过已经活了无数岁月的后期圣人。
秦羽神色平淡，从石天罡的反应，他也能大概猜到，石天罡带他来此的意图。
其中一张，在丹尊古河的手里，还有一张，在燕国皇帝的手里，最后一张，原本是在，杨豪他师父，阵法大师杨凯。
说着，见吕长老脸色稍沉，秦羽手指一动，一块令牌出现在手中。
“你是谁？你这是怎么了？”吕枫见是个重伤垂死的人，也就放下了幽冥剑，向他询问道。
天皇宫诸多武帝境长老，以及其他族人弟子，都是汇聚前来围观。
可以清楚的感知到，紫雷神霄龙身上的气势，便是以令人惊骇的速度，疯狂膨胀起来。
那校尉听了，那名人族战士的话之后，便朝着凡尘所在的地方看去。
果然，下一刻一道强悍的力量席卷过来，将两人卷出了混沌秘境。
夏树拿着排队买到的人形烧穿过热闹的商业街，找了一个广场边的长椅坐下。
咔咔！灰色星球构建起来的宇宙规则在这一刻彻底的碎裂，昔念沫感觉到周身一轻，她根本就不顾自己的伤势，数道雷剑凭空卷起，轰向了曲芃。

李力和潘宁看到众人态度，对视一眼，均从对方眼中看到一丝惊讶。
别人不知道黑三角，他还不知道吗？那可是三不管地带，鱼龙混杂。
人都是如此，当你落魄，穷困潦倒的时候，身边的亲戚朋友躲你就像躲瘟疫一般。
“每天唤醒你的，不是闹钟，而是梦想。”符初脑海里突然窜出这一句话。
而眼前这少侠，轻轻松松就拿出一枚妖兽内丹，这不得不让众人开始怀疑这少侠的身份。
吉时才到，朱凌打开大门，一时间爆竹震天响，外加一个舞狮队，铜鼓唢呐的，好不热闹，看得郑卿眼睛都亮了。
显然，兽林之王怒火冲天，想要一爪解决掉眼前这个敢挑战它权威的蝼蚁。
隐世号不断变换阵型，最终在阿瑞斯的大军出现之后定下了最终的战斗阵型。
鹰妖为了求生，强忍着心中的别扭，学着人类的语气，开口求放过。
“差不多吧，现在你把炼制七巧玲珑丹的药材拿出来，我去炼制出来。怎么也能缓解病人的痛楚。”凌渡宇对托塔天王道。
紫云儿更是一脸的震惊之色，看着自己上方的叶寒，露出吃惊之色。

Yin Tongxin upgrades much faster than Chen Xiaocao.
In less than a month, he had caught up with Chen Xiaocao's progress and reached 4 stars.
Looking at Yin Tongxin standing in front of him with a hint of showing off, Chen Xiaocao's lips curled up.
Li Tuantuan, Yang Jiajia, hold her down for me. Today I must establish my authority as the head of the family.
"Hmph." Tian Tianyuan snorted coldly. Although his plan did not expect to work, he expected that they would be able to neglect their defense so that he could take advantage of the chaos and escape. However, he did not expect that they would remain unmoved.
Nowadays, Lu Feng can no longer remember how many times he has drawn the sword. He was a little numb in the first few days, but later, every time he tried, he seriously realized where he was lacking and where he had made progress. For a while, he was immersed in it.
Li Yan now has 50% control, but when he reaches the holy realm, who doesn't practice his control to its peak? Therefore, Li Yan had no advantage at this point. Only relying on the amplification power of the last form of the Great Wilderness' magical power was still no match for the later saints who had lived for countless years.
Qin Yu's expression was calm. From Shi Tiangang's reaction, he could roughly guess Shi Tiangang's intention of bringing him here.
One of them was in the hands of Danzun Guhe, and another one was in the hands of Emperor Yan. The last one was originally in the hands of Yang Hao, his master, the formation master Yang Kai.
As he said that, seeing Elder Lu's face darken, Qin Yu moved his fingers, and a token appeared in his hand.
"Who are you? What's wrong with you?" Seeing that he was a seriously injured and dying man, Lu Feng put down his Nether Sword and asked him.
Many Martial Emperor Realm elders from the Heavenly Palace, as well as other clan disciples, gathered to watch.
It can be clearly felt that the aura of the Purple Thunder God Xiaolong is expanding crazily at a frightening speed.
After hearing what the human warrior said, the captain looked towards where Fanchen was.
Sure enough, at the next moment, a powerful force swept over and rolled the two people out of the secret realm of chaos.
Natsuki walked through the busy commercial street with the Ningyoyaki she bought in line, and found a bench by the square to sit down.
Kaka! The rules of the universe constructed by the gray planet were completely shattered at this moment. Xi Nianmo felt a lightness all over her body. Regardless of her injuries, she rolled up several thunder swords out of thin air and struck Qu Peng.
Li Li and Pan Ning saw everyone's attitude and looked at each other, seeing a hint of surprise in each other's eyes.
Others don’t know about the black triangle, so doesn’t he know about it? It was a no-nonsense zone, a mixed bag of fish and dragons.
This is true for everyone. When you are down and out, your relatives and friends will avoid you like the plague.
"What wakes you up every day is not the alarm clock, but your dreams." This sentence suddenly came to Fu Chu's mind.
The young hero in front of them easily took out a demonic beast inner elixir, which made everyone begin to doubt the young hero's identity.
When the auspicious time came, Zhu Ling opened the door, and for a moment there was a loud bang of firecrackers, plus a lion dance team, bronze drums and suona. It was so lively that Zheng Qing's eyes lit up.
Obviously, the king of the beast forest was furious and wanted to kill the ant in front of him who dared to challenge his authority.
The Hidden World kept changing its formation, and finally settled on the final battle formation after Ares' army appeared.
In order to survive, the hawk demon suppressed the awkwardness in his heart, imitated the human tone, and asked for mercy.
"That's about right. Now you take out the medicinal materials for refining the Qiqiao Linglong Pill, and I'll refine it.No matter what, it can alleviate the patient's pain. "Ling Duyu said to the Heavenly King of Tota.
Zi Yun'er had a look of shock on her face, looking at Ye Han above her with a look of surprise.
